'''Holageus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

It was the site of an intense [[Skirmish on Holageus|battle]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
